final: WITH patient_groups AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_ig_diff FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ig_diff) AS overall_avg FROM patient_groups) SELECT g.SEX, AVG(g.avg_pt), AVG(g.avg_ig_diff), AVG(g.avg_ig_diff / o.overall_avg) FROM patient_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.SEX ORDER BY g.SEX
